title: Shard Dominion
description: Late-90s Westwood-style RTS: a 17-mission three-act campaign with a branching Seal/Harness choice, 3 mechanically distinct factions (Concord shields, Emberhand salvage+stealth, Shardborn living-crystal), a research/Refinements economy, a build-defining ascending hero, tech tiers, air power, storms, a living planet that hunts the greedy, saves/replays, a mission kit, and experimental 1v1/2v2 lockstep.
